'''Patrícia Carla Serrano Gonçalves''' (born 1971) is a Portuguese physicist, politician and member of the [[Assembly of the Republic (Portugal)|Assembly of the Republic]], the national [[legislature]] of Portugal. A member of the [[LIVRE]] party, she was elected to represent [[Lisbon (Assembly of the Republic constituency)|Lisbon]] at the [[2025 Portuguese legislative election|2025 legislative election]].

==Early life==
Gonçalves was born in 1971 in [[Barreiro, Portugal|Barreiro]].<ref name="LIVRE 1">{{cite web |title=Patrícia Gonçalves |url=https://partidolivre.pt/primarias-autarquicas-2021/cmlisboa-patricia-goncalves |publisher=[[LIVRE]] |access-date=24 May 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250324175532/https://partidolivre.pt/primarias-autarquicas-2021/cmlisboa-patricia-goncalves |archive-date=24 March 2025 |location=Lisbon, Portugal |language=pt}}</ref> She has a [[Academic degree|degree]] in technological physics engineering and a [[doctorate]] in physics from the [[Instituto Superior Técnico]] (IST).<ref name="LIVRE 2">{{cite web |title=Patrícia Gonçalves |url=https://partidolivre.pt/?team=patricia-goncalves |publisher=[[LIVRE]] |access-date=24 May 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250324180607/https://partidolivre.pt/?team=patricia-goncalves |archive-date=24 March 2025 |location=Lisbon, Portugal |language=pt}}</ref>

==Career==
Gonçalves is a professor in IST's Department of Physics and a [[researcher]] at the [[Laboratory of Instrumentation and Experimental Particles Physics]] (LIP).<ref name="IST">{{cite web |title=Apresentação · Patrícia Serrano Gonçalves |url=https://fenix.tecnico.ulisboa.pt/homepage/ist24591 |publisher=[[Instituto Superior Técnico]] |access-date=24 May 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250322130722/https://fenix.tecnico.ulisboa.pt/homepage/ist24591 |archive-date=22 March 2025 |location=Lisbon, Portugal |language=pt}}</ref><ref name="LIP">{{cite web |title=Patrícia Gonçalves |url=https://www.lip.pt/?section=about&page=person-details&details&id=87 |access-date=24 May 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20241205213803/https://www.lip.pt/?section=about&page=person-details&details&id=87 |archive-date=5 December 2024 |location=Lisbon, Portugal |language=pt}}</ref> She also coordinates a group that develops [[Application software|applications]] for [[space exploration]] in association with the [[European Space Agency]] and other European scientific institutes and companies.<ref name="LIVRE 2"/> She is a member of the Association of Scientific Research Scholars ({{lang|pt|Associação dos Bolseiros de Investigação Científica}}).<ref name="LIVRE 2"/>

Gonçalves is one of the founders of the {{ill|Republic and Secularism Association|pt|Associação República e Laicidade}}.<ref name="LIVRE 2"/> She joined [[LIVRE]] in May 2014.<ref name="LIVRE 2"/> She has served a number of terms on the Contact Group, the party's [[Senior management|executive body]].<ref name="LIVRE 1"/> She was elected to the {{ill|Municipal Assembly of Lisbon|pt|Assembleia Municipal de Lisboa}} at the [[2017 Portuguese local elections|2017 local elections]] as a candidate for the Lisbon Needs Everyone ({{lang|pt|Lisboa Precisa de Todos}}) [[Electoral list|list]], a coalition between the [[Socialist Party (Portugal)|Socialist Party]] and LIVRE.<ref name="LIVRE 1"/> She was a candidate for LIVRE at the [[2019 European Parliament election in Portugal|2019 European Parliament election]] but the party failed to win any seats.<ref name="ee19">{{cite web |title=Eleições europeias 26 maio 2019: Candidatos - L |url=https://www.eleicoes.mai.gov.pt/europeias2019/candidatos.html |website=Eleições: Resultados dos Escrutínios Provisórios |publisher=[[Ministry of Internal Administration (Portugal)|Ministry of Internal Administration]] |access-date=20 May 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250212121629/https://www.eleicoes.mai.gov.pt/europeias2019/candidatos.html |archive-date=12 February 2025 |location=Lisbon, Portugal |language=pt}}</ref> She was a candidate for LIVRE at the [[2019 Portuguese legislative election|2019]], [[2022 Portuguese legislative election|2022]] and [[2024 Portuguese legislative election|2024]] legislative elections in [[Lisbon (Assembly of the Republic constituency)|Lisbon]] but was not elected.<ref name="el19">{{cite web |title=Eleições legislativas 2019 6 de outubro: Candidatos - Lisboa - L |url=https://www.eleicoes.mai.gov.pt/legislativas2019/candidatos.html |website=Eleições: Resultados dos Escrutínios Provisórios |publisher=[[Ministry of Internal Administration (Portugal)|Ministry of Internal Administration]] |access-date=24 May 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240127183241/https://www.eleicoes.mai.gov.pt/legislativas2019/candidatos.html |archive-date=27 January 2024 |location=Lisbon, Portugal |language=pt}}</ref><ref name="el22">{{cite web |title=Eleições legislativas 30 de janeiro de 2022: Candidatos - Lisboa - L |url=https://www.eleicoes.mai.gov.pt/legislativas2022/candidatos |website=Eleições: Resultados dos Escrutínios Provisórios |publisher=[[Ministry of Internal Administration (Portugal)|Ministry of Internal Administration]] |access-date=24 May 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240116151420/https://www.eleicoes.mai.gov.pt/legislativas2022/candidatos |archive-date=16 January 2024 |location=Lisbon, Portugal |language=pt}}</ref><ref name="el24">{{cite web |title=Eleições legislativas 10 de março de 2024: Candidatos - Lisboa - L |url=https://www.eleicoes.mai.gov.pt/legislativas2024/candidatos |website=Eleições: Resultados dos Escrutínios Provisórios |publisher=[[Ministry of Internal Administration (Portugal)|Ministry of Internal Administration]] |access-date=24 May 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250418050254/https://www.eleicoes.mai.gov.pt/legislativas2024/candidatos |archive-date=18 April 2025 |location=Lisbon, Portugal |language=pt}}</ref> She was elected to the [[Assembly of the Republic (Portugal)|Assembly of the Republic]] at the [[2025 Portuguese legislative election|2025 legislative election]].<ref name="el25">{{cite web |title=Eleições legislativas 18 de maio de 2025: Candidatos - Porto - L |url=https://www.legislativas2025.mai.gov.pt/candidatos |website=Eleições: Resultados dos Escrutínios Provisórios |publisher=[[Ministry of Internal Administration (Portugal)|Ministry of Internal Administration]] |access-date=24 May 2025 |archive-url= |archive-date= |location=Lisbon, Portugal |language=pt}}</ref><ref>{{cite news |last1=Begonha |first1=Ana Bacelar |title=As novas deputadas do Livre: duas professoras de Lisboa e do Porto |url=https://www.publico.pt/2025/05/20/politica/noticia/novas-deputadas-livre-duas-professoras-lisboa-porto-2133697 |access-date=24 May 2025 |work=[[Público (Portugal)|Público]] |date=20 May 2025 |location=Lisbon, Portugal |language=pt}}</ref>

==Personal life==
Gonçalves has lived in [[Lisbon]] since 2003 and has two children.<ref name="LIVRE 1"/>
